title: MCPTracer validate --json output (v2)
description: Output of `mcptracer validate <session-id> --json`. v2 adds `schema_version`, a required integer field naming the major version of this schema the document conforms to, so a CI job pinned to a schema can detect the shape it received instead of guessing from content; v1 had no version marker. Bump the filename version and add a new schema on any breaking change; do not edit this file in place once published.

healthy.description: True iff issues is empty. A CI gate should check this field, not issues.length, in case future versions add non-blocking issue kinds.

seq.description: The message sequence number the issue applies to, if any.

detail.description: Human-readable context. Never contains recorded payload values.
